); } function CartPage({ cart, updateQuantity, removeItem }) { const [customerInfo, setCustomerInfo] = useState({ name: '', surname: '', phone: '', }); const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false); const [paymentStatus, setPaymentStatus] = useState({ success: false, error: null, }); const [orderId, setOrderId] = useState(null); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false); const isFormValid = useMemo(() => { return ( customerInfo.name.trim() && customerInfo.surname.trim() && customerInfo.phone.trim() && cart.length > 0 ); }, [customerInfo, cart]); const totalAmount = useMemo(() => { return cart.reduce((total, item) => total + item.price * item.quantity, 0).toFixed(2); }, [cart]); const handleInputChange = (e) => { const { name, value } = e.target; setCustomerInfo((prevInfo) => ({ ...prevInfo, [name]: value })); }; const handlePayment = () => { setModalOpen(true); }; const confirmPayment = async () => { setLoading(true); try { // Օրդերի տվյալներ ստեղծելու համար const orderData = { customer_name: customerInfo.name, customer_surname: customerInfo.surname, customer_phone: customerInfo.phone, cart_items: cart.map(item => ({ product_id: item.id, quantity: item.quantity, price: item.price, selected_type: item.selectedType })), total_amount: parseFloat(totalAmount) }; console.log('🟡 Order Data:', orderData); // Օրդեր ստեղծենք const orderResponse = await axios.post(API_URL_Cart_Page, orderData); const billNo = orderResponse.data.order_id; if (!billNo) { throw new Error('Failed to create order'); } // Վճարման հայտ ուղարկենք const paymentResponse = await axios.post(API_URL_PAYMENT, { amount: totalAmount, billNo: billNo }); if (!paymentResponse.data.success) { throw new Error('Payment processing failed'); } // Կարճ պաուզա վիճակի թարմացման համար await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); // Դնենք billNo-ն որպես orderId setOrderId(billNo); // Իրականացնենք վճարման ձևը const paymentForm = document.getElementById('idramPaymentForm'); if (!paymentForm) { throw new Error('Payment form not found'); } paymentForm.submit(); } catch (error) { console.error('🔴 Payment Error:', error); setPaymentStatus({ success: false, error: error.message || 'An error occurred during payment' }); } finally { setLoading(false); setModalOpen(false); } }; const cancelPayment = () => { setModalOpen(false); }; return ( <>
